column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 15 (M24015): perdebatan Ateraxis dengan M4 & Commander di gerbang
# Nirvana, disela pertempuran; Ateraxis menolak mundur meski tubuhnya terurai.
# Tetap Inggris: Nirvana, Lunasia, Ateraxis, Jojo, Commander, Mother, Boojum, Lviv,
# Chiloveig, The Elmo, AR Team, M4, Soppo, Beluga, Asteria, Robella, Frame, Vindicator,
# Sangvis Ferri, Doll, Goddess.
(Ahead is Nirvana.)
column2: (Di depan adalah Nirvana.)

column1: (That is a pure white space composed of countless phenomena, the final destination of a civilization far older and more powerful than humanity, and also the starting point of this world.)
column2: (Itu ruang putih murni yang tersusun dari fenomena yang tak terhitung, tujuan akhir sebuah peradaban yang jauh lebih tua dan lebih kuat dari manusia, dan juga titik awal dunia ini.)

column1: (She has already broken through the cage Lunasia prepared for her—she should have eagerly thrown herself in there like a moth to a flame, but at this moment, Ateraxis is forced to turn around and face that human—and the five Dolls who have come to stop her.)
column2: (Dia sudah menembus kurungan yang disiapkan Lunasia untuknya—dia seharusnya sudah melempar dirinya ke sana dengan penuh gairah seperti laron ke api, tapi saat ini Ateraxis terpaksa berbalik dan menghadapi manusia itu—dan lima Doll yang datang menghentikannya.)

column1: (And among them, the beautiful girl with lovely long black hair is the one she cares about the most.)
column2: (Dan di antara mereka, gadis cantik berambut hitam panjang yang indah itulah yang paling dia perhatikan.)

column1: (Just by gazing at her, Ateraxis feels a trace of complex emotions welling up in her chest: jealousy, nostalgia, adoration, hatred, and a hint of fear that is incredibly unfamiliar to her, yet all the more distinct because of it.)
column2: (Hanya dengan menatapnya, Ateraxis merasakan segaris emosi rumit naik di dadanya: cemburu, rindu, kagum, benci, dan sedikit rasa takut yang teramat asing bagi dirinya, tapi justru karena itu terasa makin jelas.)

column1: I... am not qualified?
column2: Aku... tidak layak?

column1: There's still time. You are not welcome here, and you won't get what you want here.
column2: Masih ada waktu. Kau tidak diterima di sini, dan kau tidak akan mendapatkan yang kau inginkan di sini.

column1: 回去吧。
column2: Pulanglah.

column1: Go back...?
column2: Pulang...?

column1: I can survive in any environment, but nowhere will there be my own kind. I am not human, nor am I a Doll, and even Jojo is different from me. I have nowhere to return to.
column2: Aku bisa bertahan di lingkungan apa pun, tapi tidak ada satu tempat pun yang punya jenisku. Aku bukan manusia, bukan pula Doll, dan bahkan Jojo berbeda dariku. Aku tidak punya tempat untuk pulang.

column1: Only you, only Lunasia, can understand this loneliness, right?
column2: Hanya kau, hanya Lunasia, yang bisa memahami kesepian ini, kan?

column1: It's not like that.
column2: Bukan begitu.

column1: I have my companions, and the Commander.
column2: Aku punya rekan-rekanku, dan Commander.

column1: Even if we're not together, I have everyone in my heart, and everyone has never forgotten me in their hearts.
column2: Meski kami tidak bersama, semuanya ada di hatiku, dan mereka pun tidak pernah melupakanku di hati mereka.

column1: I am absolutely not lonely, and you can find it too, as long as you give your true heart.
column2: Aku sama sekali tidak kesepian, dan kau juga bisa menemukannya, asal kau memberikan hatimu yang sejati.

column1: Sincerity?
column2: Ketulusan?

column1: What is that? Don't use such abstract words to describe things that don't exist.
column2: Apa itu? Jangan memakai kata seabstrak itu untuk menggambarkan hal yang tidak ada.

column1: Even we Dolls can have things we cherish at the bottom of our neural clouds, it's impossible for you not to have any.
column2: Bahkan kami para Doll bisa punya hal yang kami sayangi di dasar neural cloud, mustahil kau tidak punya satu pun.

column1: Right now, you're like a villain in a vulgar movie, blindly pursuing things you don't even need.
column2: Sekarang kau seperti penjahat di film murahan, membabi buta mengejar hal yang bahkan tidak kau butuhkan.

column1: Cherish... need...
column2: Menyayangi... membutuhkan...

column1: If you mean caring... I, once cared about Mother, and Jojo; also, I am... very interested in the Commander. But, this is not enough, and this is not the meaning of my existence.
column2: Kalau maksudmu peduli... aku pernah peduli pada Mother, dan Jojo; dan juga, aku... sangat tertarik pada Commander. Tapi itu tidak cukup, dan itu bukan makna keberadaanku.

column1: You don't need to be manipulated by 'Mother', Ateraxis.
column2: Kau tidak perlu dikendalikan 'Mother', Ateraxis.

column1: There are still many things in this world you haven't experienced or felt. Delving deeper into Nirvana will only lead to your destruction.
column2: Masih banyak hal di dunia ini yang belum kau alami atau rasakan. Masuk lebih dalam ke Nirvana hanya akan menuntunmu ke kehancuran.

column1: Commander, this is not Mother's order, didn't I tell you?
column2: Commander, ini bukan perintah Mother, bukannya sudah kubilang?

column1: When I boarded The Elmo and opened the gates of Nirvana, I had already forsaken Mother and embarked on this lonely path of the flaming sword.
column2: Saat aku menaiki The Elmo dan membuka gerbang Nirvana, aku sudah meninggalkan Mother dan melangkah ke jalan pedang berapi yang sepi ini.

column1: What exactly do you want to get from here? To rule the world as the Queen of the Boojum?
column2: Sebenarnya apa yang kau mau dapatkan dari sini? Menguasai dunia sebagai Ratu Boojum?

column1: I don't like Boojum, they are just my food.
column2: Aku tidak suka Boojum, mereka hanya makananku.

column1: ...Huh?
column2: ...Hah?

column1: Hah!? But aren't you yourself...
column2: Hah!? Tapi bukannya kau sendiri...

column1: My body is composed of Boojum cells, but humans are also composed of various cells. In your eyes, the Commander is the Commander, and wouldn't be seen as just a collection of cells, right?
column2: Tubuhku tersusun dari sel Boojum, tapi manusia juga tersusun dari berbagai sel. Di matamu, Commander adalah Commander, dan tidak dilihat cuma sebagai kumpulan sel, kan?

column1: Mother used Boojum cells, human genes, and the essence of Nirvana from when Lviv was opened to create me, Ateraxis.
column2: Mother memakai sel Boojum, gen manusia, dan sari Nirvana dari saat Lviv dibuka untuk menciptakan aku, Ateraxis.

column1: At that time...
column2: Waktu itu...

column1: Yes, although Mother did not permit Chiloveig's actions, she still achieved her goal from that "opening" and created me.
column2: Benar, meski Mother tidak mengizinkan tindakan Chiloveig, dia tetap mendapat tujuannya dari "pembukaan" itu dan menciptakanku.

column1: I am not a Boojum, nor am I human. There is no individual in the world similar to me. Mother said I am a brand new species—but this species only has me as its single individual.
column2: Aku bukan Boojum, bukan pula manusia. Tidak ada individu di dunia yang serupa denganku. Mother bilang aku spesies yang benar-benar baru—tapi spesies ini hanya punya aku sebagai satu-satunya individunya.

column1: I want kin.
column2: Aku ingin punya kerabat.

column1: Commander, in your eyes, are you and I kin?
column2: Commander, di matamu, apa kau dan aku ini kerabat?

column1: Regardless of what kind of structure the body is, life with autonomous consciousness can inherently communicate and coexist.
column2: Apa pun struktur tubuhnya, kehidupan dengan kesadaran mandiri pada dasarnya bisa berkomunikasi dan hidup bersama.

column1: But to be honest, humans can't do the things you do.
column2: Tapi sejujurnya, manusia tidak bisa melakukan hal-hal yang kau lakukan.

column1: But compared to Lunasia at this moment, we are undoubtedly closer, aren't we?
column2: Tapi dibanding Lunasia saat ini, kita tidak diragukan lebih dekat, kan?

column1: (Looking at Ateraxis's expression, I seemed to suddenly understand what she meant.)
column2: (Menatap ekspresi Ateraxis, aku seolah tiba-tiba memahami apa yang dia maksud.)

column1: Mother said that without an observer, things have no meaning. Although the 'Goddess' is the supreme observer in Nirvana, she still has to rely on members of civilization to do so.
column2: Mother bilang tanpa pengamat, segala hal tidak punya makna. Meski 'Goddess' adalah pengamat tertinggi di Nirvana, dia tetap harus bergantung pada anggota peradaban untuk melakukannya.

column1: And I will not die, nor will I age. As long as I can connect to Nirvana, I can continuously learn and evolve.
column2: Dan aku tidak akan mati, tidak akan menua. Selama aku bisa tersambung ke Nirvana, aku bisa terus belajar dan berevolusi.

column1: So I hope to become friends with the Lunasia over there, and then, we can together make the world—
column2: Jadi aku ingin berteman dengan Lunasia di sana, lalu bersama-sama kami bisa membuat dunia—

column1: Nirvana is not such a convenient thing. Intervening in the fate of the world requires paying a price.
column2: Nirvana bukan hal yang sepraktis itu. Ikut campur dalam takdir dunia menuntut pembayaran harga.

column1: This is not a blessing, but a curse.
column2: Ini bukan berkah, tapi kutukan.

column1: You are just noise disturbing Lunasia. Everything she faces is not something you can understand. I cannot let you bother her.
column2: Kau hanya derau yang mengganggu Lunasia. Semua yang dia hadapi bukan hal yang bisa kau pahami. Aku tidak bisa membiarkanmu mengganggunya.

column1: You're a lot like my 15, waking up every day and immediately making an enemy of the world.
column2: Kau sangat mirip 15-ku, bangun tiap hari lalu langsung memusuhi dunia.

column1: With the enemy right in front of us, could you not kick me at the slightest disagreement... Is your rebellious phase not over yet?
column2: Dengan musuh tepat di depan kita, bisa tidak kau berhenti menendangku begitu ada beda pendapat sedikit... Masa membangkangmu belum selesai?

column1: If someone could share her duties as an observer, she should be very happy.
column2: Kalau ada yang bisa membagi tugasnya sebagai pengamat, dia seharusnya sangat senang.

column1: If one day this 'price' causes her to perish, she would need a successor.
column2: Kalau suatu hari 'harga' itu membuatnya musnah, dia akan butuh penerus.

column1: Is her refusal at this moment really for the operation of the world—or is it merely the rejection and isolation of a 'lower' existence by a 'higher' race?
column2: Apa penolakannya saat ini benar demi berjalannya dunia—atau hanya penolakan dan pengucilan eksistensi yang 'lebih rendah' oleh ras yang 'lebih tinggi'?

column1: That's not it, you just aren't qualified. Although Boojum cells can allow Nirvana to accept you, you wouldn't be able to withstand the consciousness within it afterwards.
column2: Bukan begitu, kau hanya tidak layak. Meski sel Boojum bisa membuat Nirvana menerimamu, setelah itu kau tidak akan sanggup menahan kesadaran yang ada di dalamnya.

column1: When that time comes, you will be devoured, and you'll cause trouble for Lunasia and reality as well.
column2: Saat itu terjadi, kau akan ditelan, dan kau juga akan menyusahkan Lunasia serta dunia nyata.

column1: You are not Lunasia herself after all, and you cannot understand my power... If you try to stop me, even if you are the goddess's envoy, I will step over your wreckage to move forward.
column2: Lagi pula kau bukan Lunasia sendiri, dan kau tidak bisa memahami kekuatanku... Kalau kau mencoba menghentikanku, meski kau utusan dewi itu, aku akan melangkahi bangkaimu untuk maju.

column1: ...Stop spouting all this wishful thinking just because it suits you.
column2: ...Berhenti melontarkan angan-angan hanya karena itu cocok untukmu.

column1: You're just a brat who wants to mess up the world because you're afraid of being lonely. Evaporating you on a molecular level is the most lenient treatment we can offer you.
column2: Kau cuma anak kecil yang mau mengacaukan dunia karena takut kesepian. Menguapkanmu sampai tingkat molekul adalah perlakuan paling lunak yang bisa kami tawarkan.

column1: What a shame, you were just talking to me about true feelings and whatnot.
column2: Sayang sekali, tadi kau baru bicara padaku soal perasaan yang sejati dan sebagainya.

column1: But as long as it's different from the world humans want, you'll immediately become my enemy—this is why Mother said you can only be used as tools, right?
column2: Tapi selama itu berbeda dari dunia yang diinginkan manusia, kalian langsung jadi musuhku—inilah sebabnya Mother bilang kalian hanya bisa dipakai sebagai alat, kan?

column1: In my world, no Dolls are needed.
column2: Di duniaku, Doll tidak dibutuhkan.

column1: Then, I have no choice but to stop you at all costs.
column2: Kalau begitu, aku tidak punya pilihan selain menghentikanmu dengan segala cara.

column1: (The Commander raised the gun—in the previous world, this action might have made Ateraxis find it laughable.)
column2: (Commander mengangkat pistolnya—di dunia sebelumnya, tindakan itu mungkin membuat Ateraxis menganggapnya lucu.)

column1: (Even if she stood still, bullets or shells couldn't cause effective damage, but in Nirvana, this rule has been overturned.)
column2: (Meski dia berdiri tak bergerak, proyektil atau peluru artileri tidak bisa menimbulkan kerusakan berarti, tapi di Nirvana aturan itu terjungkir.)

column1: (This person's bullets—can already hurt her. Although Ateraxis knows she can still easily dodge the trajectories of all the opponent's weapons, 'absolute victory' no longer exists.)
column2: (Proyektil orang ini—sudah bisa melukainya. Meski Ateraxis tahu dia masih bisa dengan mudah mengelak dari lintasan semua senjata lawannya, 'kemenangan mutlak' sudah tidak ada.)

column1: Commander... you are truly cruel. I have always treated you differently, yet you always... refuse to show me favoritism.
column2: Commander... kau benar-benar kejam. Aku selalu memperlakukanmu secara berbeda, tapi kau selalu... menolak memberiku keistimewaan.

column1: No, this is the person I... we have chosen.
column2: Tidak, inilah orang yang aku... yang kami pilih.

column1: AR Team, follow the Commander!
column2: AR Team, ikuti Commander!

column1: Since M4 said so, let's begin!
column2: Karena M4 sudah bilang begitu, mari mulai!

column1: (The first to act is always Soppo. Ateraxis can't tell which is more deadly, the ammunition she pours out or her approaching claws.)
column2: (Yang pertama bergerak selalu Soppo. Ateraxis tidak bisa membedakan mana yang lebih mematikan, amunisi yang dia semburkan atau cakarnya yang mendekat.)

column1: (The Doll girl's actions are as fast as her thoughts. Soppo also seems to have mastered the trick of "teleporting" with her mind. However, she cannot find any weaknesses on Ateraxis.)
column2: (Gerakan gadis Doll itu secepat pikirannya. Soppo juga sepertinya sudah menguasai trik "berpindah tempat" dengan pikiran. Namun dia tidak bisa menemukan satu pun kelemahan pada Ateraxis.)

column1: —Hmph, can Dolls move like this in Nirvana? Then, I can too.
column2: —Hmph, Doll bisa bergerak seperti ini di Nirvana? Kalau begitu, aku juga bisa.

column1: (She tries to let her consciousness rather than her motor nerves take over her body, using her mind to dominate movement and space. The next moment she appears behind Soppo. Ateraxis kicks through Soppo's flank, sending her flying.)
column2: (Dia mencoba membiarkan kesadarannya, bukan saraf motoriknya, mengambil alih tubuhnya, memakai pikirannya untuk menguasai gerak dan ruang. Sesaat kemudian dia muncul di belakang Soppo. Ateraxis menendang tembus sisi Soppo, melemparkannya terbang.)

column1: How is it? Lunasia, are you watching?
column2: Bagaimana? Lunasia, kau menonton?

column1: (Ateraxis guessed—that existence unwilling to contact her, Lunasia, was watching this conflict with great interest.)
column2: (Ateraxis menduga—eksistensi yang tidak mau berkontak dengannya itu, Lunasia, sedang menonton konflik ini dengan penuh minat.)

column1: (And what she wasn't quite sure of was—was there something else also watching here? An audience that even Lunasia hadn't noticed...)
column2: (Dan yang belum dia pastikan adalah—apakah ada hal lain yang juga menonton di sini? Penonton yang bahkan tidak disadari Lunasia...)

column1: Are you spacing out?
column2: Kau melamun?

column1: Don't joke around.
column2: Jangan bercanda.

column1: (She has always been capable of multi-threaded thinking, so being distracted is not the reason Beluga caught her. It's just that the greatsword in her hand seemed to foresee her actions and blocked her path. Ateraxis's hand grips a pale battleaxe, parrying Beluga's slash, but she is then entangled by Soppo.)
column2: (Dia selalu mampu berpikir multi-alur, jadi terpecahnya perhatian bukan alasan Beluga bisa menangkapnya. Hanya saja pedang besar di tangan Beluga seolah meramalkan gerakannya dan menghadang jalannya. Tangan Ateraxis mencengkeram kapak perang pucat, menangkis tebasan Beluga, tapi lalu dia dibelit Soppo.)

column1: (They coordinate flawlessly, but Ateraxis's weapon has accumulated her own energy, which hasn't failed even in the Nirvana space. Axe and sword clash, a dazzling light erupts, Beluga's weapon bounces upward, and Ateraxis swiftly pierces her torso with a hand blade.)
column2: (Koordinasi mereka tanpa cela, tapi senjata Ateraxis sudah mengumpulkan energinya sendiri, yang bahkan di ruang Nirvana tidak gagal. Kapak dan pedang berbenturan, cahaya menyilaukan meletus, senjata Beluga terpental ke atas, dan Ateraxis cepat menembus badannya dengan bilah tangan.)

column1: ...You hit really hard, little girl.
column2: ...Pukulanmu keras sekali, nak.

column1: Unfortunately, for a Doll, it doesn't end that simply.
column2: Sayangnya, untuk seorang Doll, urusannya tidak berakhir sesederhana itu.

column1: (Doll fluid and sparks splattered from the wound together, yet Beluga continued to laugh and talk cheerfully. Ateraxis originally wanted to crush her neural core inside her body, but her hand was firmly clamped by the Frame instead—Beluga's Frame could bite even with its wounds. Ateraxis released an energy shield to block Beluga's fierce attack, finally pulling her hand out and flipping the other party to the ground.)
column2: (Cairan Doll dan bunga api menyemprot bersama dari lukanya, tapi Beluga tetap tertawa dan bicara riang. Ateraxis semula ingin menghancurkan inti neural di dalam tubuhnya, tapi tangannya justru terjepit kuat oleh Frame itu—Frame Beluga bisa menggigit bahkan dengan lukanya. Ateraxis melepas pelindung energi untuk menahan serangan ganas Beluga, akhirnya menarik tangannya keluar dan membalikkan lawannya ke tanah.)

column1: (Asteria blasted her with the Vindicator's long-charged second attack at the perfect moment. The energy beam, composed of something beyond common sense, pierced the barrier. Ateraxis was sent flying heavily, part of her body sublimating under the high temperature that burned its very essence.)
column2: (Asteria menghajarnya dengan serangan kedua Vindicator yang lama diisi daya, tepat di momen yang sempurna. Sinar energi yang tersusun dari sesuatu di luar akal sehat itu menembus penghalangnya. Ateraxis terlempar keras, sebagian tubuhnya menyublim di bawah suhu tinggi yang membakar sari keberadaannya.)

column1: (She turned her actions into consciousness, disappearing from mid-air in an instant, but noticed that M4 had simultaneously moved behind her. Their eyes met, and words intertwined in each other's consciousness.)
column2: (Dia mengubah tindakannya menjadi kesadaran, hilang dari udara dalam sekejap, tapi menyadari M4 serentak berpindah ke belakangnya. Mata mereka bertemu, dan kata-kata berjalin di kesadaran masing-masing.)

column1: The Nirvana space is not as convenient as you imagine... you're being used!
column2: Ruang Nirvana tidak sepraktis yang kau bayangkan... kau sedang dimanfaatkan!

column1: You think everything is your own wish, but what truly guides you is the will of an existence you cannot comprehend at all!
column2: Kau menganggap semuanya keinginanmu sendiri, tapi yang benar-benar mengarahkanmu adalah kehendak eksistensi yang sama sekali tidak bisa kau pahami!

column1: Then let Lunasia come out and tell me herself!
column2: Kalau begitu suruh Lunasia keluar dan mengatakannya sendiri padaku!

column1: (M4's rifle fires at Ateraxis's back. The strong impact forces her to the ground, and the pouring bullets burn with pure white flames, preventing her Boojum cells from regenerating.)
column2: (Senapan M4 menembak punggung Ateraxis. Hantaman kuat itu memaksanya ke tanah, dan proyektil yang mencurah membara dengan api putih murni, mencegah sel Boojum-nya beregenerasi.)

column1: (Even so, Ateraxis does not waver. This grotesque battle will not end with the disintegration of the flesh. She looks at her true opponent—the Commander stands there, not speaking or giving orders, because his thoughts are already linked as one with the AR Team.)
column2: (Meski begitu, Ateraxis tidak goyah. Pertempuran ganjil ini tidak akan berakhir dengan terurainya daging. Dia menatap lawan sesungguhnya—Commander berdiri di sana, tidak bicara atau memberi perintah, karena pikirannya sudah tertaut menjadi satu dengan AR Team.)

column1: (Ateraxis disappears under M4's hail of bullets, but between her and the Commander, a figure stands firmly in the middle, blocking her on the outside.)
column2: (Ateraxis hilang di bawah hujan proyektil M4, tapi di antara dia dan Commander, sebuah figur berdiri kokoh di tengah, menghadangnya dari luar.)

column1: Don't even think about it.
column2: Jangan berpikir untuk itu.

column1: (The Doll Ateraxis originally despised the most executes a clean upward kick. Ateraxis instinctively dodges the attack, but her body sways slightly—M4's attack seems to have stripped her of a massive amount of energy. The strange flare gun in Robella's hand releases a shockwave, pushing Ateraxis's body backward.)
column2: (Doll yang semula paling dipandang rendah Ateraxis melepas tendangan naik yang bersih. Secara refleks Ateraxis mengelak dari serangan itu, tapi tubuhnya sedikit terhuyung—serangan M4 sepertinya sudah menguras energinya dalam jumlah masif. Pistol flare aneh di tangan Robella melepas gelombang kejut, mendorong tubuh Ateraxis ke belakang.)

column1: (Asteria, Beluga, and Soppo took turns attacking her. Her shield seemed unable to function properly under Robella's interference, so she deflected the attacks with battle axes and blades projected by Boojum cells, and shattered Asteria's right arm joint. However, the bullets fired by M4 could not be defended against in this way.)
column2: (Asteria, Beluga, dan Soppo menyerangnya bergantian. Pelindungnya sepertinya tidak bisa bekerja dengan benar di bawah gangguan Robella, jadi dia menangkis serangan itu dengan kapak perang dan bilah yang diproyeksikan sel Boojum, lalu menghancurkan sambungan lengan kanan Asteria. Namun proyektil yang ditembakkan M4 tidak bisa ditahan dengan cara itu.)

column1: (A hail of bullets poured down, piercing her hands and feet. Ateraxis tried to let her mind guide her body, disappearing from her spot several times, but M4 was waiting at the destination every time. Was it 'her' or the Commander who saw through her actions? Ateraxis wasn't sure, perhaps it was the result of their joint effort?)
column2: (Hujan proyektil mencurah, menembus tangan dan kakinya. Ateraxis mencoba membiarkan pikirannya mengarahkan tubuhnya, hilang dari tempatnya beberapa kali, tapi M4 selalu menunggu di titik tujuannya. Apa 'dia' atau Commander yang membaca gerakannya? Ateraxis tidak yakin, mungkin itu hasil kerja mereka bersama?)

column1: (Robella approached Ateraxis this time. Originally, Ateraxis didn't care about the fist she swung, until she noticed that her hand was wreathed in the same flames as Lunasia's bullets—)
column2: (Kali ini Robella yang mendekati Ateraxis. Semula Ateraxis tidak peduli pada pukulan yang dia ayunkan, sampai dia menyadari tangan Robella terbalut api yang sama dengan proyektil Lunasia—)

column1: (She detonated a shockwave, knocking the third-generation Doll away, but the Commander, already protected by Asteria and Beluga, showed no openings. Ateraxis nimbly dodged Soppo's pounce and landed on the other side of the pure white space.)
column2: (Dia meledakkan gelombang kejut, melempar Doll generasi ketiga itu menjauh, tapi Commander yang sudah dilindungi Asteria dan Beluga tidak memperlihatkan celah. Ateraxis dengan gesit mengelak dari terjangan Soppo dan mendarat di sisi lain ruang putih murni itu.)

column1: So this is combat in the Nirvana space... very interesting.
column2: Jadi ini pertempuran di ruang Nirvana... sangat menarik.

column1: I feel like you're gradually discovering your potential.
column2: Aku merasa kalian berangsur menemukan potensi kalian.

column1: (Her gaze turned to those five Dolls—and then to that human.)
column2: (Tatapannya beralih ke lima Doll itu—lalu ke manusia itu.)

column1: Not considering surrender?
column2: Tidak mempertimbangkan menyerah?

column1: I won't give up. Besides, even in Nirvana, frame damage cannot be recovered, and I've already memorized their tactical movements.
column2: Aku tidak akan menyerah. Lagi pula, bahkan di Nirvana kerusakan frame tidak bisa dipulihkan, dan aku sudah menghafal gerakan taktis mereka.

column1: After coming all this way, you're still trying to persuade me to turn back, to return empty-handed to... where? Mother's side?
column2: Sudah sampai sejauh ini, kau masih mencoba membujukku berbalik, pulang dengan tangan kosong ke... mana? Ke sisi Mother?

column1: That's still better than you losing everything here.
column2: Itu tetap lebih baik daripada kau kehilangan segalanya di sini.

column1: I never had anything to begin with, Commander.
column2: Sejak awal aku tidak pernah punya apa pun, Commander.

column1: If I go back, nothing will change, and I will only become more empty and desperate—because even if I reach the place where God is, I still won't get the answers I want.
column2: Kalau aku pulang, tidak ada yang berubah, dan aku hanya akan makin hampa dan putus asa—karena meski aku mencapai tempat God berada, aku tetap tidak akan mendapat jawaban yang kuinginkan.

column1: I don't want to just be Mother's tool. I want to have my own future—isn't that the same as you? I always thought, always thought, that you would understand me, Commander.
column2: Aku tidak ingin cuma jadi alat Mother. Aku ingin punya masa depanku sendiri—bukankah itu sama sepertimu? Aku selalu berpikir, selalu berpikir, bahwa kau akan memahamiku, Commander.

column1: (Despite her persistent refusal, Ateraxis did not attack again. On the contrary, she looked at him with almost a hint of eagerness, listening to his voice.)
column2: (Meski terus menolak, Ateraxis tidak menyerang lagi. Sebaliknya, dia menatapnya dengan hampir sedikit rasa berharap, mendengarkan suaranya.)

column1: (She realized she was so lonely that even seeing the enemies who came to stop her made Ateraxis feel a genuine sense of comfort and joy.)
column2: (Dia menyadari dia begitu kesepian sampai bahkan melihat musuh yang datang menghentikannya membuat Ateraxis merasakan kenyamanan dan kegembiraan yang sungguhan.)

column1: (Because at this very moment, she was arguing with someone else as an equal.)
column2: (Karena tepat pada saat itu, dia berdebat dengan orang lain sebagai sesama yang setara.)

column1: (This was the first time.)
column2: (Itulah kali pertamanya.)

column1: You can try getting along with people who are different from you, and try not to rely solely on your own strength to solve all problems.
column2: Kau bisa mencoba akrab dengan orang yang berbeda darimu, dan mencoba tidak hanya mengandalkan kekuatanmu sendiri untuk menyelesaikan semua masalah.

column1: Life isn't as complicated as you think. Didn't you also admit that you hope someone can accept you?
column2: Hidup tidak serumit yang kau pikirkan. Bukannya kau juga mengakui bahwa kau berharap ada yang bisa menerimamu?

column1: Aside from the ridiculous title of 'perfect creature,' there are many other choices waiting for you.
column2: Selain gelar konyol 'makhluk sempurna' itu, masih banyak pilihan lain yang menunggumu.

column1: Then, Commander, will you accept me? Let me live on your Elmo with your Dolls, give me an equal share of love, and call me family?
column2: Kalau begitu, Commander, kau mau menerimaku? Membiarkanku tinggal di Elmo-mu bersama Doll-Doll-mu, memberiku bagian kasih yang setara, dan menyebutku keluarga?

column1: If you're willing to give up your original goal, I'll give it a try.
column2: Kalau kau bersedia meninggalkan tujuan awalmu, aku akan mencobanya.

column1: Hehe... I know your answer, but it's meaningless.
column2: Hehe... aku tahu jawabanmu, tapi itu tidak berarti.

column1: Because you are ultimately just human. Even if you possess stronger vitality and a longer lifespan than other humans, compared to me, it's merely a fleeting moment.
column2: Karena pada akhirnya kau hanya manusia. Meski kau punya daya hidup lebih kuat dan usia lebih panjang dari manusia lain, dibandingkan aku itu hanya sekejap.

column1: After you die as a human, who will you belong to? A heart that has tasted hope once will only become desperate again—you've merely postponed it. After being left behind by you, who should I believe in?
column2: Setelah kau mati sebagai manusia, kau akan jadi milik siapa? Hati yang sudah sekali mengecap harapan hanya akan kembali putus asa—kau cuma menundanya. Setelah ditinggalkan olehmu, aku harus percaya pada siapa?

column1: You'll have to find that out yourself.
column2: Itu harus kau temukan sendiri.

column1: Both humans and Dolls are like this. Even Lunasia, I think she is also searching for some kind of answer.
column2: Manusia maupun Doll sama saja. Bahkan Lunasia, kurasa dia juga sedang mencari semacam jawaban.

column1: I'm very tempted, but I can already foresee the outcome. You will break your promise, Commander. And when that time comes, I will only be even more desperate.
column2: Aku sangat tergoda, tapi aku sudah bisa meramalkan hasilnya. Kau akan melanggar janjimu, Commander. Dan saat itu terjadi, aku hanya akan makin putus asa.

column1: What a stubborn brat.
column2: Anak yang keras kepala sekali.

column1: I don't deny my youth; after all, it hasn't even been a year since I was born.
column2: Aku tidak menyangkal aku masih muda; lagi pula belum genap setahun sejak aku lahir.

column1: But just like you Dolls, age does not define me. The knowledge and experience I have mastered so far far exceed a hundred times the limit of a human lifetime.
column2: Tapi sama seperti kalian para Doll, umur tidak mendefinisikanku. Pengetahuan dan pengalaman yang kukuasai sejauh ini jauh melampaui seratus kali batas satu usia manusia.

column1: So what? You're just a brat, even more childish than Soppo.
column2: Terus? Kau tetap cuma anak kecil, bahkan lebih kekanakan dari Soppo.

column1: Commander, look at this Sangvis Ferri boss, she's bullying me.
column2: Commander, lihat bos Sangvis Ferri ini, dia mengganggu aku.

column1: Burrowing around everywhere just because you feel there are no peers in the real world, and running to a world that doesn't belong to you to cause trouble, can hardly be called well-mannered.
column2: Menggerogoti ke mana-mana hanya karena kau merasa tidak ada yang sederajat di dunia nyata, lalu berlari ke dunia yang bukan milikmu untuk membuat masalah, itu sulit disebut beradab.

column1: However, I should thank you.
column2: Namun, aku harus berterima kasih padamu.

column1: ...Thank, me?
column2: ...Terima kasih, padaku?

column1: If you hadn't caused such a mess, we wouldn't have seen M4 again.
column2: Kalau kau tidak membuat kekacauan sebesar itu, kami tidak akan bertemu M4 lagi.

column1: That's why I didn't kill you right away.
column2: Karena itu aku tidak langsung membunuhmu.

column1: I feel the same way.
column2: Perasaanku sama.

column1: If you put it that way, I'm the same.
column2: Kalau kau bilang begitu, aku juga sama.

column1: But that's a separate matter. We don't want M4 to be troubled by someone like you.
column2: Tapi itu urusan lain. Kami tidak ingin M4 disusahkan orang sepertimu.

column1: This is your final warning. Are you willing to give up?
column2: Ini peringatan terakhirmu. Kau mau menyerah?

column1: To see Lunasia, I will destroy all of you.
column2: Demi menemui Lunasia, aku akan menghancurkan kalian semua.

column1: Even so, you won't get what you want.
column2: Meski begitu, kau tidak akan mendapat yang kau inginkan.

column1: The self that belongs to you, which you have firmly grasped all this time, is your last chance right now. If you abandon it to further touch Nirvana, it will only bring you complete destruction, and even then... you cannot force 'her' to do anything.
column2: Diri yang menjadi milikmu, yang selama ini kau pegang kuat-kuat, adalah kesempatan terakhirmu sekarang. Kalau kau membuangnya demi menyentuh Nirvana lebih jauh, itu hanya membawa kehancuran total bagimu, dan bahkan setelah itu... kau tidak bisa memaksa 'dia' melakukan apa pun.

column1: If I were insignificant, you wouldn't need to return to Nirvana with the Commander to stop me.
column2: Kalau aku tidak berarti, kau tidak perlu kembali ke Nirvana bersama Commander untuk menghentikanku.

column1: The fact that you are here means there must be a power within me capable of threatening her, and even the entirety of Nirvana.
column2: Fakta bahwa kau ada di sini berarti pasti ada kekuatan dalam diriku yang mampu mengancam dia, bahkan seluruh Nirvana.

column1: And this is what I must figure out—even if I can't find my own kind, remain forever lonely, ultimately face destruction, and make the Commander hate me.
column2: Dan inilah yang harus kupahami—meski aku tidak bisa menemukan jenisku, tetap kesepian selamanya, akhirnya menghadapi kehancuran, dan membuat Commander membenciku.

column1: I want to understand Lunasia further. This is my own selfishness—and also my way of fulfilling my duty.
column2: Aku ingin memahami Lunasia lebih jauh. Ini keegoisanku sendiri—dan juga caraku menuntaskan tugasku.

column1: (Under Ateraxis's confession, everyone understood a truth—her opposition to the "Goddess" was destined.)
column2: (Di bawah pengakuan Ateraxis, semua orang memahami satu kebenaran—perlawanannya terhadap "Goddess" itu sudah ditakdirkan.)

column1: (To some extent, Ateraxis viewed the Earth and humanity as a part of herself—and naturally, she would not allow a stronger existence to decide everything, resulting in her only being able to drift with the tide.)
column2: (Sampai batas tertentu, Ateraxis memandang Bumi dan manusia sebagai bagian dari dirinya—dan wajar dia tidak akan membiarkan eksistensi yang lebih kuat memutuskan segalanya, sehingga dia hanya bisa terhanyut arus.)

column1: Then it's a pity, Ateraxis, but we must settle this once and for all.
column2: Kalau begitu sayang sekali, Ateraxis, tapi kita harus menyelesaikan ini sekali untuk selamanya.

column1: ...No need to be so depressed, Commander. Only here do you have the possibility of killing me. Representative of humanity, my respected and beloved nemesis, won't you seize this one and only chance?
column2: ...Tidak perlu semuram itu, Commander. Hanya di sini kau punya kemungkinan membunuhku. Perwakilan manusia, musuhku yang kuhormati dan kusayangi, kau tidak mau memanfaatkan satu-satunya kesempatan ini?

column1: ...Yeah, but I originally didn't want to choose this.
column2: ...Iya, tapi semula aku tidak ingin memilih ini.

column1: (Just as Ateraxis said, this is Nirvana. What determines victory or defeat is not the strength of the frame or the physical body, but a rule based on willpower. It is precisely because of this that Robella and the others can use power they originally didn't possess.)
column2: (Seperti kata Ateraxis, ini Nirvana. Yang menentukan kalah atau menang bukan kekuatan frame atau tubuh fisik, tapi aturan yang berdasar pada kemauan. Justru karena itulah Robella dan yang lain bisa memakai kekuatan yang semula tidak mereka miliki.)

column1: (Although I can't say I've mastered everything, I've gradually grasped the way to fight here—and I've also gained a better understanding of this place.)
column2: (Meski aku tidak bisa bilang sudah menguasai semuanya, aku berangsur memahami cara bertarung di sini—dan aku juga jadi lebih memahami tempat ini.)

column1: Then, Commander.
column2: Kalau begitu, Commander.

column1: Try and kill me.
column2: Coba bunuh aku.

column1: Otherwise, I'm going to see Lunasia, you know?
column2: Kalau tidak, aku akan menemui Lunasia, lho?

column1: (Ateraxis revealed a faint smile. For a moment, perhaps she really did think about giving up, surrendering to the humans and Dolls before her, and believing that she could nurture a hope she had never had before.)
column2: (Ateraxis menampakkan senyum samar. Sesaat, mungkin dia benar-benar berpikir untuk menyerah, tunduk pada manusia dan Doll di depannya, dan percaya dia bisa menumbuhkan harapan yang belum pernah dia miliki.)

column1: (But she couldn't believe in such a future. Accustomed only to power and relying only on power, she couldn't believe in anything other than herself.)
column2: (Tapi dia tidak bisa percaya pada masa depan seperti itu. Terbiasa hanya pada kekuatan dan hanya bergantung pada kekuatan, dia tidak bisa percaya pada apa pun selain dirinya sendiri.)

column1: (Unless it was something more powerful than herself.)
column2: (Kecuali sesuatu yang lebih kuat dari dirinya.)

column1: AR Team, continue combat operations. No need to hold back anymore.
column2: AR Team, lanjutkan operasi tempur. Tidak perlu menahan diri lagi.

column1: Copy that!
column2: Dimengerti!

column1: (If it were the original Ateraxis, with her rationality—she might have been able to understand the facts M4 stated.)
column2: (Kalau ini Ateraxis yang semula, dengan nalarnya—dia mungkin bisa memahami fakta yang dikatakan M4.)

column1: (Unfortunately, because she diverted part of her willpower and self-control to maintain her body against the repulsion, decomposition, and erosion originating from Nirvana itself, Ateraxis's thoughts incorporated more emotion and self-awareness than ever before.)
column2: (Sayangnya, karena dia mengalihkan sebagian kemauan dan kendali dirinya untuk menjaga tubuhnya melawan penolakan, penguraian, dan pengikisan yang berasal dari Nirvana itu sendiri, pikiran Ateraxis memuat lebih banyak emosi dan kesadaran diri dari sebelumnya.)

column1: (I think that's exactly why M4 chose to have me and the AR Team come here to assist her in battle.)
column2: (Kurasa justru itulah sebabnya M4 memilih membawaku dan AR Team ke sini untuk membantunya bertempur.)

column1: (Nirvana is by no means a realm that ordinary creatures can touch; it will indiscriminately tear apart any unaccepted bloodline. Even if I am a so-called 'partial immune body,' I can only move right now by relying on M4's protection, while Ateraxis—)
column2: (Nirvana sama sekali bukan ranah yang bisa disentuh makhluk biasa; ia akan mencabik tanpa pilih kasih garis darah mana pun yang tidak diterima. Meski aku disebut 'tubuh imun sebagian', sekarang aku hanya bisa bergerak dengan mengandalkan perlindungan M4, sementara Ateraxis—)

column1: (Even though she still looks so powerful, I can tell from her expression of enduring pain and the wounds on her body's surface that are constantly disintegrating and healing—she is marching towards weakness simply by existing here.)
column2: (Meski dia masih tampak begitu kuat, dari ekspresinya yang menahan sakit dan luka di permukaan tubuhnya yang terus terurai lalu menutup—aku bisa melihat dia melangkah menuju kelemahan hanya dengan berada di sini.)
